capital.name: Mexico City
capital.shortDescription: A vast capital of museums, street food, murals, music, and layered pre-Hispanic and modern urban life.

prompts.prompt: Which country is associated with Frida Kahlo, tacos, and mariachi?
Tamales, mole, and tacos are strongly associated with which country?
Frida Kahlo is most closely associated with which country?

reveal.intro: Mexico feels expansive, sensorial, and deeply made by region. Food, public art, street life, architecture, and memory all arrive with unusual force.

heroImage.alt: Historic urban streetscape in Mexico with color and architecture

funFacts: Mexican cuisine is shaped by strong regional traditions, so dishes and flavors vary widely across the country.
Mexico has one of the richest mural traditions in the world, tying art directly to public space and civic memory.
Its capital is one of the largest cities in the world and one of the most museum-rich.

items.name: Tacos al pastor
items.description: Thin-sliced pork carved from a spit, tucked into tortillas, and brightened with pineapple, onion, and salsa.
items.whyItMatters: They carry migration, city life, and pure craveability all at once, making them one of the most immediate ways into Mexico's everyday food culture.

items.name: Chavela Vargas
items.description: A singular voice whose stripped-back ranchera performances feel raw, intimate, and impossible to mistake for anyone else.

items.name: Natalia Lafourcade
items.description: A contemporary artist whose music blends intimacy, craft, and a deep connection to Latin American musical traditions.

items.name: Pedro Paramo
items.creator: Juan Rulfo
items.description: A short, haunting novel whose atmosphere and voice have influenced generations of writers far beyond Mexico.

items.name: Coyoacan
items.description: A historic district in Mexico City where tree-lined streets, markets, cafes, color, and artistic memory all fold into each other.
items.whyItMatters: It gives a more lived-in image of Mexico than a single monument and makes the country's urban texture feel tangible.

items.name: Frida Kahlo
items.description: A globally recognizable artist whose work turns pain, style, symbolism, and self-fashioning into an unmistakable visual language.

items.name: Mexico City
items.description: Mexico City is a layered cultural giant, full of museums, street food, muralism, parks, markets, and neighborhoods with distinct personalities.
